biological_replicate: Experiments using single, binary, and tertiary combinations of the microbial species along with a sterile control were carried out in triplicates.
experimental_design: comparison between continuous culture and bioleaching (mineral) samples
compare the intensities with two-sample Welch’s t test (mineral or continuous)
factor_value: culture condition (continuous, mineral), microbial composition (single, binary, tertiary combinations of L. ferriphilum, S. thermosulfidooxidans, and A. caldus)
Three bacterial acidophile species were used: Leptospirillum ferriphilumT DSM 14647, Sulfobacillus thermosulfidooxidansT DSM 9293, and Acidithiobacillus caldusT DSM 8584.
number_of_biological_replicates: Experiments using single, binary, and tertiary combinations of the microbial species along with a sterile control were carried out in triplicates.
number_of_samples: Proteomics data for three continuous culture samples and 61 bioleaching samples was deposited at the PRIDE database.
